capabilities: Display library in a card gallery view
extras: The plugin stores the Aladin TTB key in plain text in the vault's .obsidian/plugins/digital-archive/data.json.
motivation: Aladin exposes a free open API with detailed Korean and foreign book metadata. This plugin turns a title search into a ready-to-use note (cover, author, publisher, page count, ISBN, reading status) and renders every book note as a cover-first gallery, so your vault doubles as a personal bookshelf.
problem: Manually creating detailed notes for books and organizing a digital library within Obsidian is cumbersome.

relations.evidence: so you do not need Dataview, Templater, or a theme snippet.
